title: Squeeze the Corner
setup: Black's king sits on b1 with a pawn on f6 far away, and your queen and bishop are both in range.
hint: The king has four squares. Find the move that leaves it one, then look at what happens there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd2}} covers b2, c1 and c2 in one stroke and gives no check at all. {{Ka1}} is forced, and {{Qc1#}} finishes. The quiet move is stronger than the check because it removes the escape rather than chasing it.
